data.title: 间桐樱 · 雨中车站·伞下守候与安静侧颜
data.description: 【间桐樱 · 雨中车站·伞下守候与安静侧颜】淅淅沥沥的冬雨中，樱撑着一把淡粉色的雨伞静静伫立在车站出站口。雨水溅湿了她的裙摆，但看到你走出闸机的那一瞬间，她清澈的紫眸里立刻盈满了全部的光彩——「学长！太好了，我一直很担心你没带伞……只要能等到学长，无论等多久都不冷。」
data.promptProse: Beneath a pale pink umbrella outside the station exit, Sakura lifts her eyes as the person she has been waiting for comes through the gates beyond the frame. One hand holds the umbrella shaft steadily and the other rests against the front of her closed winter coat. Rain gathers in shallow puddles near her shoes, with the damp skirt hem visible below the coat. Soft overcast light keeps the umbrella fabric pink and her relieved expression clear. The medium view includes the exit canopy and sheltered figure, without lettering.
data.location: 车站出站口外的冬雨中
data.action: 撑淡粉伞在出站口外等候，看到同行者出闸机后抬眼微笑
